2609.21519.title: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks
2609.21519.paper_summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimisation and AI-native intelligence. Rather than viewing optimisation merely as an online decision engine, the proposed paradigm redefines optimisation algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models. The resulting models inherit optimisation expertise while enabling low-latency runtime inference suitable for dynamic network environments. A generic four-stage L2O workflow is introduced, comprising optimisation, knowledge generation, surrogate learning, and runtime inference. Unlike existing Learning-to-Optimize approaches, which primarily focus on algorithm acceleration, the proposed framework establishes L2O as an architectural abstraction applicable across heterogeneous communication and computing systems. The proposed paradigm is illustrated by an NR-V2X relay-selection problem, in which optimisation-generated solutions from a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solver are used to train a Graph Neural Network that can reproduce near-optimal decisions in real time. The presented perspective positions Learning-to-Optimize as a key architectural enabler for future AI-native networks.
2609.21519.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）正逐漸成為未來 AI 原生通信網絡的基本設計原則，使自主資源管理、自適應控制和零觸控網絡運營成為可能。儘管當前的 AI 原生架構越來越多地將智能嵌入網絡功能中，但它們對於如何系統性地生成、轉移和利用優化知識以供 AI 模型使用卻提供了很少的指導。本文主張，學習優化（Learning-to-Optimize, L2O）代表了優化與 AI 原生智能之間缺失的架構層。該提議的範式不僅僅將優化視為在線決策引擎，而是重新定義優化算法為離線知識生成器，這些生成器為神經替代模型產生高質量的監督信息。由此產生的模型繼承了優化專業知識，同時實現了適合動態網絡環境的低延遲運行時推理。介紹了一個通用的四階段 L2O 工作流程，包括優化、知識生成、替代學習和運行時推理。與現有的學習優化方法主要集中於算法加速不同，所提框架將 L2O 確立為一種適用於異構通信和計算系統的架構抽象。通過 NR-V2X 中繼選擇問題來說明所提範式，其中優化生成的解決方案來自混合整數線性規劃（MILP）求解器，並用來訓練一個圖神經網絡，該網絡能夠實時重現近乎最佳的決策。所提出的觀點將學習優化定位為未來 AI 原生網絡的關鍵架構推動者。
